Neptune Ops is the Influence Operating System for the AI Age. We build and deploy the most advanced digital tools to drive outcomes in public affairs and other precision advertising campaigns across the country. We help our clients avoid the pitfalls of technology disruptions, and capitalize on the opportunities created by these changes. 
 



  





 As our company continues to grow, you’ll be an important part of building tools for the future of AI\-driven persuasion. You’ll see in real time how empowering clients to leverage the latest technology has a tremendous impact on policy, public affairs, elections, and precision B2B advertising. This role is ideal for software engineers with experience contributing to real\-world, production systems. You’ll work across the stack to build and improve core product features, collaborate closely with other engineers and product stakeholders, and use modern infrastructure and AI\-integrated systems. You’ll also support the development of early\-stage systems where patterns are still being defined, with the opportunity to influence both product and technical direction. This position reports directly to the Chief Technology Officer (CTO). As a scaling start\-up company, there are endless opportunities to take on challenging assignments and grow.
 



  





 What you’ll do:
 



  





 This position designs and builds core full\-stack systems across our platform, including:
 



  




* End\-to\-end features spanning frontend interfaces and backend APIs that power data\-heavy applications
* Data models and APIs that support complex workflows (e.g., campaigns, entities, influence networks)
* Interactive frontend experiences for exploring, managing, and acting on real\-time data
* Systems that connect user actions to backend state, analytics, and decision\-making workflows
* Integrations with external APIs and data providers across both frontend and backend layers
* AI\-assisted workflows, including research interfaces, memo systems, and agent\-driven features
* Early\-stage product surfaces where both system design and user experience are still being defined

* 2\-4 years of hands\-on software development experience
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and/or Python
* Familiarity with modern web frameworks (React, Next.js, or similar)
* Experience working with APIs and backend services
* Understanding of databases (SQL and/or NoSQL)
* Ability to work across the stack and learn new technologies quickly in a flexible fast\-paced start\-up environment
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail
* Excellent project and time management skills
* Professional, highly organized, detail\-oriented, and proactive
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Must be located in San Francisco Bay Area

 Frontend
 


* React
* Next.js
* TypeScript
* TailwindCSS



  





 Backend
 


* Python (FastAPI)

 Data \& Storage

 Infrastructure \& DevOps
 


* Docker
* AWS (EC2, S3\)
* Nginx
* GitHub Actions



  





 Other Tools
 


* External APIs
* LLM APIs and AI tooling



  





 Nice to haves:
 



  




* Exposure to LLMs or AI/ML\-powered applications
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS)
* Experience with Docker and CI/CD pipelines
* Interest in data visualization or analytics platforms
* Interest in public affairs, advocacy, or related fields
* Prior experience of knowledge graph databases



  





 How you'll work:
 



  




* We prioritize shipping quickly to \~80% and refining based on real usage.
* We value engineers who can balance speed and polish.
* We value engineers who can think across the full stack, connecting user experience with system design and data models.
* You’ll be expected to make decisions around both frontend implementation and backend architecture, not just one layer.



  





 What to expect:
 



  





 Our interview process is straightforward and designed to be respectful of your time. You'll start with an informational interview to learn more about the role and share your background. From there, you'll meet with our CTO for a technical conversation that includes a coding exercise. Final\-round candidates will join a conversation with both the CTO and CEO.

description_preview:
**About Moder**
 Moder is an AI\-enabled, human\-powered digital services company built for mortgage, insurance, and financial services. We meet clients where they are, tackle the toughest industry challenges, and build solutions that hold up in production environments where the stakes are real. Our partnership with Palantir brings Foundry and AIP to clients who need to move from AI experimentation to operational reality.
   

  

 We have served clients across the full mortgage lifecycle, from origination through capital markets and are now expanding that same operational depth into insurance and broader financial services. We RAISE the bar every day: Results, Accountability, Innovation, Service, Excellence.
   

  

**THE OPPORTUNITY**
 Moder is building its first cohort of Forward Deployment Engineers and we are doing it intentionally, carefully, and with you at the center of the design. The FDE Fast Track Program is a full\-time, structured launch pad for recent graduates who want to do more than start a career. We are looking for people who want to help build one. Candidates in this Cohort will be the first people to go through “Foundry Academy”, the first to deploy on live client engagements, the first to stress\-test our training curriculum, and the first to tell us what works and what doesn't. Your feedback will directly shape how Moder trains, develops, and grows FDEs for years to come. That is not a responsibility we take lightly and it is not an opportunity that comes around often. This program is for engineers who are technically sharp and genuinely curious about how AI gets deployed in the real world, not in demos, but inside financial institutions with messy data, legacy systems, and high stakes. If you want to understand how AI changes how a business operates, this is where that learning happens.
   

  

*You will not be an observer. You are a contributor. From week one, you will be working on real problems, inside real platforms, alongside experienced engineers who are counting on your thinking, not just your output.*
**What You Will Do**
 You will work across three interconnected areas simultaneously. These are not phases, they happen together, from the beginning.
   

  

**Essential Job Duties And Responsibilities**
**Technical Delivery \& Platform Engineering**
* Work on active Palantir Foundry deployments alongside senior FDEs, owning defined scopes within real client engagements — not sandbox projects.
* Build data pipelines, ontology structures, and workflow automations in Foundry's Pipeline Builder and Workshop — moving from supported execution to independent delivery as your confidence builds.
* Wrangle real, complex financial services datasets: cleaning, transforming, integrating, and making them usable inside Palantir's ontology layer. The data will not be clean. That is the point.
* Develop hands\-on proficiency in Foundry's core tools: Pipeline Builder, Workshop, Ontology Manager, Code Repositories, and AIP.
* Contribute to architecture and technical design discussions — your perspective as someone newer to the platform is genuinely valuable, not just tolerated.
* Build working familiarity with AI and LLM\-driven workflows through Palantir AIP, understanding where AI adds real operational value and where it doesn't.


**Client Engagement \& Collaboration**
* Participate in client\-facing sessions — discovery meetings, technical reviews, status updates — alongside senior FDEs, learning and contributing from the first month.
* Support training and handoff sessions for client teams, helping communicate what has been built and why it works the way it does.
* Develop the ability to translate technical realities into business language across a range of audiences, from data analysts to C\-suite executives.
* Represent Moder in\-person at client locations when travel is required, carrying the kind of credibility that comes from actually knowing the work.


**Program Development \& Field Intelligence**
* Participate actively in Moder Academy — our structured onboarding covering the mortgage lifecycle, insurance operations, Palantir Foundry, and client engagement frameworks — and tell us honestly what is missing or unclear.
* Maintain a structured learning log throughout the program, capturing client patterns, platform observations, and deployment insights that feed directly back to Moder's product and training teams.
* Complete a capstone project — a client\-facing workflow or internal accelerator that you own end\-to\-end — and present it to Moder leadership at the close of your program.
* Provide formal feedback at structured checkpoints that will be used to improve the program for Cohort 2\. Your candor is valued, not just encouraged.


**Other Job Duties And Responsibilities**
* Performs other related duties as assigned.
* Comply with all company policies and procedures.
* Maintain regular and punctual attendance.


**What We Are Looking For**
*We are not looking for the most experienced candidate. We are looking for the most curious candidates, with the technical foundation to do real work and the disposition to thrive in environments that are still being defined.*
**Qualifications**
 To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential function satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.
   

  

**Required**
* Recent graduate (undergraduate or graduate) with a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related technical field.
* Programming ability in Python — you write it independently, not just read it. Data manipulation, API calls, scripting, and a working understanding of how data moves between systems.
* Working SQL proficiency for querying and exploring datasets; comfort working with structured data at meaningful scale.
* A highly analytical mindset: you break problems down, find the data that matters, and build a structured case for what to do — rather than waiting for direction.
* High degree of intellectual curiosity and inquisitiveness — you ask questions others skip past, investigate the edges of problems, and are never fully satisfied with 'it works.'
* Clear communication in writing and in conversation, to both technical and non\-technical audiences. We will assess this directly in the interview process.
* Comfort with ambiguity and open\-ended environments where what you need to do is discovered through engagement, not handed down in a spec.
* Ability to commute to and work from Philadelphia at least three days per week.


**Preferred**
* Coursework, projects, or research involving data engineering, machine learning, enterprise data platforms, or applied AI. Foundry experience is rare at this level — curiosity and technical aptitude matter far more.
* Any exposure to AI/ML concepts including LLMs, retrieval\-augmented generation, or agentic systems — enough to understand why they matter in an enterprise context.
* Prior experience in a client\-facing, consulting, or applied research capacity — you have translated between technical work and a non\-technical audience before.
* Background or coursework in financial services, mortgage, insurance, or a regulated industry. You do not need to be an expert — an informed curiosity is enough.
* Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) at any level.


**What's In It For You**
 We know you have options. Here is why you should choose Moder:
   

  

**Ownership from Day One**
 You will not spend your first months observing. You will be given defined ownership over real scopes within live client engagements. When something ships, your name is on it.
   

  

**Training That Is Actually Designed Around You**
 Moder Academy is a comprehensive onboarding program covering the mortgage and insurance lifecycle, Palantir Foundry platform certification, and Moder's client engagement framework. As a Cohort 1, you also get to improve it. If something is missing or unclear, we want to know — and we will fix it.
   

  

**A Mentor Who Is Actually Invested**
 Every candidate is paired with a dedicated senior FDE from day one. Weekly 1:1s, structured feedback, and real mentorship — not a name on an org chart. Your mentor's goal is to help you get to Associate FDE, and their success is tied to yours.
   

  

**Philadelphia Presence — Built\-In Community**
 The hybrid model is not a compromise — it is a feature. Three days in the office means you are in the same room as the team, learning through proximity, building relationships that remote work cannot replicate. Philadelphia is also a growing hub for financial services technology, and being embedded in that environment matters for your career.
   

  

**A Career Path With No Guesswork**
 The program is an explicit entry point to the FDE track. Strong performance converts directly to an Associate FDE offer. The path after that is written down, not implied: Associate FDE → FDE → Senior FDE → Principal FDE. Your advancement is tied to what you deliver, not how long you wait.
   

  

**The Chance To Shape What Comes Next**
 Cohort 1 will have more influence over Moder's FDE program than any group that follows. The playbooks you help build, the feedback you provide, and the standards you set will define what Moder looks for and how it develops engineers for years. That is a real legacy.
   

  

**About The Fde Fast Track Program \& Career Path**
*The FDE Fast Track Program is not a trial period — it is the beginning of a career track. Candidates in Cohort 1, who perform will receive Associate FDE offers. The track beyond that is clear and merit\-based.*
**The Full Path**
**FDE → Associate FDE → FDE → Senior FDE → Principal FDE**
 Advancement is tied to client outcomes, technical depth, and the quality of insight you bring back to Moder's product and training teams — not to time in seat. The best FDEs at Moder shape what we build next.

**Summary**
 The AI Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions that support intelligent automation, predictive insight, and advanced analytics across the enterprise. As a hands\-on builder, this role applies software engineering principles to write production\-quality code, build scalable AI systems, including AI Agents and data pipelines, and integrate AI models into new and existing business applications. The AI Engineer collaborates closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, ML Ops Engineers, and Platform teams to bring machine learning models from prototype to production. A critical part of this function is to ensure that AI use cases are transitioned from experimentation into reliable, governed, and business\-ready solutions by owning their complete operational readiness. This includes implementing robust observability, defining Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and establishing clear incident response and rollback strategies for all AI services.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
 Model Development \& Implementation
   

  

* Write clean, efficient, and well\-documented code to develop and implement machine learning and AI models that support various business use cases.
* Implement data engineering and preprocessing workflows required for model inputs.
* Continuously optimize the performance and scalability of AI applications and models.
* Support the migration and retirement of legacy systems by using Generative AI tools to help analyze, document, and draft modern application code.

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable ML pipelines for model training, validation, inference, and deployment.

**Job Description**
 The Voice Artificial Intelligence (AI) Lab at USF Health's Department of Otolaryngology – Head \& Neck Surgery is a translational research laboratory. The lab is dedicated to advancing the diagnosis and treatment of voice and swallowing disorders through artificial intelligence, machine learning, and speech technology. The work sits at the intersection of clinical medicine, acoustics, and data science — developing AI\-powered tools that improve patient outcomes and expand access to voice care.
   

  

 The AI Healthcare Engineer will play a central role in designing, building, and deploying machine learning and AI systems for clinical voice analysis and voice\-related applications. Working closely with clinicians, researchers, and data scientists, this individual will help translate cutting\-edge research into functional tools used in both the lab and the clinical setting. This is an exciting opportunity for an early\-career engineer passionate about healthcare AI and voice technology to grow in a highly collaborative, mission\-driven environment.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Artificial Intelligence (AI) \& Machine Learning Development
   

  

* Design, train, and evaluate machine learning models for voice disorder detection, classification, and severity assessment.
* Develop and fine\-tune deep learning architectures (CNNs, RNNs, Transformers) for audio and speech signal processing.
* Build and maintain data pipelines for acoustic feature extraction, preprocessing, and model training.
* Integrate large language models (LLMs) and speech\-to\-text systems into clinical and research workflows.


 Software Engineering \& Deployment
   

  

* Develop clean, well\-documented, and reproducible code in Python for research and production use.
* Build REST APIs and backend services to expose AI model functionality to clinical applications.

description_preview:
**About Hoonify** 




 Hoonify delivers secure, sovereign AI infrastructure designed for the next generation of inference workloads. Powered by TurbOS®, our platform enables organizations and NeoCloud/data center operators to transform CPU/GPU infrastructure into production\-ready AI environments—supporting local LLMs, agentic copilots, RAG, and embeddings. We empower teams with robust model lifecycle management, multi\-tenant controls, usage metering, and fully auditable operations.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We are seeking a System Software Engineer to help build, deploy, and operate our multi\-cloud computational platform and model\-serving infrastructure underpinning our AI/ML developer platform. This role focuses on implementation, automation, and day\-to\-day operation of production systems, working under the technical direction of senior engineers and the platform's established architectural patterns.
 



  





 The successful candidate will deliver well\-engineered, well\-tested infrastructure changes, and grow their depth across Kubernetes, GPU\-backed workloads, observability, and continuous delivery in a production environment.
 



  





 This role enables meaningful growth in cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, and ML serving. You will work directly with senior engineers on real production systems, receive code and design review on your work, and have a clear path to expand scope and ownership as your experience deepens.
 



  





**Core Responsibilities** 



* Implement and maintain Kubernetes workloads and supporting resources, including manifests, Helm charts, controllers, and configuration for networking, ingress, and storage, following established platform patterns.
* Deploy and operate model\-serving workloads on GPU and accelerator node pools, including configuring autoscaling policies, resource requests and limits, and tenant\-specific deployment configurations.
* Support model training and simulation workloads on distributed GPU systems.
* Build and maintain instrumentation on Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry, including authoring dashboards, alerting rules, and trace and metric instrumentation for new services.
* Implement and improve CI/CD pipelines, including build, test, and deployment automation, and contribute to progressive delivery practices already in use on the platform.

**Job Summary:**
**SmithRx Mission:** 
 SmithRx is on a mission to disrupt the expensive and inefficient Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) sector by building a next\-generation drug acquisition platform driven by cutting\-edge technology. We are seeking a highly specialized and visionary
 **Identity Engineer** 
 to architect, build, and govern the unified identity ecosystems that secure our human workforce, cloud infrastructure, and autonomous AI agents.
   

  

**The Role Environment:**

 **Lehi, UT** 
 office and is available to work on\-site Monday through Friday. As an Identity Engineer, you will serve as the technical cornerstone of the
 **Identity \& Access** 
 pod. You will lead strategic initiatives to modernize our identity stack, moving beyond traditional IAM to pioneer Non\-Human Identity (NHI) and AI agent governance in a strictly regulated healthcare environment (HIPAA).
   

  

**Success Profile:** 
 We are looking for an Okta expert who understands policy\-based cloud authorization and loves designing secure, 'paved road' identity solutions that empower developers rather than slowing them down.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* **Core IAM \& Lifecycle Automation:** 
 Architect and manage HR\-driven provisioning by integrating Okta with Workday (Workday\-as\-a\-Master) to automate complex attribute mapping and secure JML (Joiner/Mover/Leaver) lifecycles.
* **SaaS Ecosystem Security:** 
 Engineer and deploy robust SSO (SAML 2\.0, OIDC, OAuth 2\.0\) and SCIM provisioning for major enterprise applications, particularly Salesforce and Google Workspace.
* **Cloud Identity Architecture:** 
 Design least\-privilege policies and manage AWS Identity Security, including cross\-account role assumption, identity federation via Okta, and AWS SSO (Identity Center).
* **Policy\-Based Access Control (PBAC):** 
 Implement decoupled authorization for cloud\-native applications utilizing Open Policy Agent (OPA) and authoring strict access policies in Rego.
* **AI Agent Governance:**

 Rocket Lab is an end\-to\-end space company delivering responsive launch services, complete spacecraft design and manufacturing, payloads, satellite components, and more – all with the goal of opening access to space. The rockets and satellites we build and launch enable some of the most ambitious and vital space missions globally, supporting scientific exploration, Earth observation and missions to combat climate change, national security, and exciting new technology demonstrations.
   

  

 Our Electron rocket has become the second most frequently launched U.S. rocket annually and has delivered more than 230 satellites to orbit, all while we work to develop Neutron, our upcoming medium\-lift, reusable launch vehicle for larger constellation deployment.
